title: Hal Puthoff's medieval levitating secret society

tellings.quote: me off and he goes or it could be a medieval secret society that knows how to levitate and they put these metal capsules around them

plain: The UFO phenomenon might, by one idea, be the work of a medieval secret society that knows how to levitate and puts metal capsules around its members. Michels tells this as something the physicist Hal Puthoff said to him, apparently half in jest, while discussing what could lie behind the phenomenon. If true, it would mean the craft are human, not alien.
